datasets.name: e316b200
queryLines:
SELECT
    MONTH(month_start_date) AS calendar_month,
    ROUND(AVG(monthly_return_pct), 2) AS avg_return_pct
FROM gold.etf_month_by_month_performance

datasets.name: 90ee599e
queryLines:
SELECT
    p.symbol,
    COALESCE(m.etf_name, p.symbol) AS etf_name,

    MONTH(p.month_start_date) AS calendar_month,

    CONCAT(
        LPAD(MONTH(p.month_start_date), 2, '0'),
        ' ',
        DATE_FORMAT(
            MAKE_DATE(
                2000,
                MONTH(p.month_start_date),
                1
            ),
            'MMM'
        )
    ) AS month_label,

    ROUND(
        AVG(p.monthly_return_pct),
        2
    ) AS avg_monthly_return_pct

FROM gold.etf_month_by_month_performance p

LEFT JOIN reference.etf_metadata m
    ON p.symbol = m.symbol

WHERE p.monthly_return_pct IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY
    p.symbol,
    m.etf_name,
    MONTH(p.month_start_date)

ORDER BY
    p.symbol,
    calendar_month;

datasets.name: 8386a00d
queryLines:
WITH completed_monthly_returns AS (

    SELECT
        symbol,
        month_start_date,
        monthly_return_pct
    FROM gold.etf_month_by_month_performance
    WHERE month_start_date <
          CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE)
      AND monthly_return_pct IS NOT NULL

),

latest_reporting_month AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(month_start_date) AS reporting_month
    FROM completed_monthly_returns

),

latest_price AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(price_date) AS latest_price_date
    FROM silver.etf_prices_cleaned
),

latest_returns AS (

    SELECT
        r.symbol,
        r.month_start_date,
        r.monthly_return_pct
    FROM completed_monthly_returns r
    INNER JOIN latest_reporting_month lm
        ON r.month_start_date = lm.reporting_month

),

market_statistics AS (

    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) AS etfs_tracked,

        ROUND(
            AVG(monthly_return_pct),
            2
        ) AS avg_monthly_return_pct,

        ROUND(
            100.0
            * SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN monthly_return_pct > 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
            / COUNT(*),
            1
        ) AS positive_etf_ratio_pct

    FROM latest_returns

),

best_etf AS (

    SELECT
        r.symbol AS best_symbol,
        COALESCE(m.etf_name, r.symbol) AS best_etf_name,
        ROUND(r.monthly_return_pct, 2) AS best_return_pct
    FROM latest_returns r
    LEFT JOIN reference.etf_metadata m
        ON r.symbol = m.symbol

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            r.monthly_return_pct DESC,
            r.symbol
    ) = 1

),

worst_etf AS (

    SELECT
        r.symbol AS worst_symbol,
        COALESCE(m.etf_name, r.symbol) AS worst_etf_name,
        ROUND(r.monthly_return_pct, 2) AS worst_return_pct
    FROM latest_returns r
    LEFT JOIN reference.etf_metadata m
        ON r.symbol = m.symbol

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            r.monthly_return_pct ASC,
            r.symbol
    ) = 1

)

SELECT
    lm.reporting_month,
    DATE_FORMAT(
    lm.reporting_month,
    'MMMM yyyy'
) AS reporting_month_label,
    DATE_FORMAT(
    lp.latest_price_date,
    'MMMM d, yyyy'
) AS latest_price_date_label, 
    ms.etfs_tracked,
    ms.avg_monthly_return_pct,
    ms.positive_etf_ratio_pct,

    b.best_symbol,
    b.best_etf_name,
    b.best_return_pct,

    w.worst_symbol,
    w.worst_etf_name,
    w.worst_return_pct,

    1 AS header_display_value

FROM latest_reporting_month lm
CROSS JOIN market_statistics ms
CROSS JOIN best_etf b
CROSS JOIN worst_etf w
CROSS JOIN latest_price lp;

datasets.name: fcd56975

FROM VALUES
    ('1M', 1),
    ('3M', 2),
    ('6M', 3),
    ('YTD', 4),

    ('5Y', 7),

datasets.name: f40a0bc2
queryLines:
WITH parameter_value AS (

    SELECT UPPER(:time_horizon) AS time_horizon

),

latest_completed_month AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(month_start_date) AS latest_month

    FROM gold.etf_month_by_month_performance

    WHERE month_start_date <
          CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE)

),

period_configuration AS (

    SELECT
        p.time_horizon,
        l.latest_month,

        CASE p.time_horizon
            WHEN '1M'
                THEN l.latest_month

            WHEN '3M'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_month, -2)

            WHEN '6M'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_month, -5)

            WHEN 'YTD'
                THEN CAST(
                    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', l.latest_month)
                    AS DATE
                )

            WHEN '1Y'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_month, -11)

            WHEN '3Y'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_month, -35)

            WHEN '5Y'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_month, -59)

            WHEN 'MAX'
                THEN DATE '1900-01-01'
        END AS required_start_month,

        CASE p.time_horizon
            WHEN '1M' THEN 1
            WHEN '3M' THEN 3
            WHEN '6M' THEN 6
            WHEN 'YTD' THEN MONTH(l.latest_month)
            WHEN '1Y' THEN 12
            WHEN '3Y' THEN 36
            WHEN '5Y' THEN 60
            WHEN 'MAX' THEN NULL
        END AS expected_months

    FROM parameter_value p
    CROSS JOIN latest_completed_month l

),

selected_monthly_returns AS (

    SELECT
        p.symbol,
        p.month_start_date,
        p.monthly_return_pct,
        c.time_horizon,
        c.latest_month,
        c.expected_months

    FROM gold.etf_month_by_month_performance p
    CROSS JOIN period_configuration c

    WHERE p.month_start_date
              BETWEEN c.required_start_month
                  AND c.latest_month

      AND p.monthly_return_pct IS NOT NULL

),

compounded_performance AS (

    SELECT
        symbol,
        time_horizon,

        MIN(month_start_date) AS period_start_month,
        MAX(month_start_date) AS period_end_month,

        COUNT(*) AS months_available,
        MAX(expected_months) AS expected_months,

        ROUND(
            100 * (
                EXP(
                    SUM(
                        LN(
                            1 + monthly_return_pct / 100.0
                        )
                    )
                ) - 1
            ),
            2
        ) AS period_return_pct

    FROM selected_monthly_returns

    GROUP BY
        symbol,
        time_horizon

)

SELECT
    p.symbol,
    COALESCE(m.etf_name, p.symbol) AS etf_name,
    m.asset_class,
    m.region,
    m.category,

    p.time_horizon,
    p.period_start_month,
    p.period_end_month,
    p.months_available,

    p.period_return_pct,

    CASE
        WHEN p.period_return_pct >= 0 THEN 'Positive'
        ELSE 'Negative'
    END AS return_direction

FROM compounded_performance p

LEFT JOIN reference.etf_metadata m
    ON p.symbol = m.symbol

WHERE p.time_horizon = 'MAX'
   OR p.months_available = p.expected_months

ORDER BY
    p.period_return_pct DESC,
    p.symbol;

datasets.name: 53aaa356
queryLines:
WITH parameter_value AS (

    SELECT UPPER(:time_horizon) AS time_horizon

),

latest_completed_month AS (

    SELECT MAX(month_start_date) AS latest_month
    FROM gold.etf_month_by_month_performance
    WHERE month_start_date <
          CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE)

),

period_configuration AS (

    SELECT
        p.time_horizon,
        l.latest_month,

        CASE p.time_horizon
            WHEN '1M'  THEN l.latest_month
            WHEN '3M'  THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_month, -2)
            WHEN '6M'  THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_month, -5)
            WHEN 'YTD' THEN CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', l.latest_month) AS DATE)
            WHEN '1Y'  THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_month, -11)
            WHEN '3Y'  THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_month, -35)
            WHEN '5Y'  THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_month, -59)
            WHEN 'MAX' THEN DATE '1900-01-01'
        END AS return_start_month

    FROM parameter_value p
    CROSS JOIN latest_completed_month l

),

selected_returns AS (

    SELECT
        p.symbol,
        p.month_start_date,
        p.monthly_return_pct,
        c.time_horizon

    FROM gold.etf_month_by_month_performance p
    CROSS JOIN period_configuration c

    WHERE p.month_start_date
          BETWEEN c.return_start_month AND c.latest_month

      AND p.monthly_return_pct IS NOT NULL

),

cumulative_growth AS (

    SELECT
        symbol,
        month_start_date,
        time_horizon,

        ROUND(
            100 * EXP(
                SUM(
                    LN(1 + monthly_return_pct / 100.0)
                ) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY symbol
                    ORDER BY month_start_date
                    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                )
            ),
            2
        ) AS normalized_value

    FROM selected_returns

),

starting_points AS (

    SELECT
        symbol,
        ADD_MONTHS(MIN(month_start_date), -1) AS month_start_date,
        MAX(time_horizon) AS time_horizon,
        100.00 AS normalized_value

    FROM selected_returns

    GROUP BY symbol

),

combined AS (

    SELECT * FROM starting_points
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM cumulative_growth

)

SELECT
    c.symbol,
    COALESCE(m.etf_name, c.symbol) AS etf_name,
    c.month_start_date,
    c.time_horizon,
    c.normalized_value

FROM combined c

LEFT JOIN reference.etf_metadata m
    ON c.symbol = m.symbol

ORDER BY
    c.symbol,
    c.month_start_date;

datasets.name: 6d697d1c
queryLines:
WITH all_available_returns AS (

    SELECT
        month_start_date,
        MONTH(month_start_date) AS calendar_month,
        monthly_return_pct

    FROM gold.etf_month_by_month_performance

    WHERE monthly_return_pct IS NOT NULL

),

monthly_statistics AS (

    SELECT
        calendar_month,

        DATE_FORMAT(
            MAKE_DATE(2000, calendar_month, 1),
            'MMMM'
        ) AS month_name,

        ROUND(
            AVG(monthly_return_pct),
            2
        ) AS avg_return_pct,

        ROUND(
            100.0 * AVG(
                CASE
                    WHEN monthly_return_pct > 0 THEN 1.0
                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            ),
            1
        ) AS positive_ratio_pct,

        COUNT(*) AS observations

    FROM all_available_returns

    GROUP BY calendar_month

),

strongest_month AS (

    SELECT
        calendar_month,
        month_name,
        avg_return_pct,
        positive_ratio_pct,
        observations

    FROM monthly_statistics

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            avg_return_pct DESC,
            calendar_month
    ) = 1

),

weakest_month AS (

    SELECT
        calendar_month,
        month_name,
        avg_return_pct,
        positive_ratio_pct,
        observations

    FROM monthly_statistics

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            avg_return_pct ASC,
            calendar_month
    ) = 1

),

most_consistent_month AS (

    SELECT
        calendar_month,
        month_name,
        avg_return_pct,
        positive_ratio_pct,
        observations

    FROM monthly_statistics

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            positive_ratio_pct DESC,
            avg_return_pct DESC,
            calendar_month
    ) = 1

),

coverage AS (

    SELECT
        MIN(month_start_date) AS first_month,
        MAX(month_start_date) AS latest_month

    FROM all_available_returns

)

SELECT
    s.month_name AS strongest_month,
    s.avg_return_pct AS strongest_return_pct,
    s.positive_ratio_pct AS strongest_month_positive_ratio_pct,

    w.month_name AS weakest_month,
    w.avg_return_pct AS weakest_return_pct,
    w.positive_ratio_pct AS weakest_month_positive_ratio_pct,

    c.month_name AS consistent_month,
    c.positive_ratio_pct AS consistent_positive_ratio_pct,
    c.avg_return_pct AS consistent_month_avg_return_pct,

    DATE_FORMAT(v.first_month, 'MMM yyyy') AS first_month_label,
    DATE_FORMAT(v.latest_month, 'MMM yyyy') AS latest_month_label,

    CASE
        WHEN v.latest_month =
             CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE)
        THEN 'Includes current month-to-date data'
        ELSE 'Completed months only'
    END AS data_scope_label

FROM strongest_month s

CROSS JOIN weakest_month w
CROSS JOIN most_consistent_month c
CROSS JOIN coverage v;
